name: Garages/carports
description:
Wooden garages and carports

16 wooden garages, carports and garage-carport combinations from €2,871 to €11,767, with 13 to 50 m² under cover. All have 44 mm solid log walls and a pine structure. Delivered as a kit to the UK, Ireland and Europe.

Garage or carport

Garage. Closed and lockable, with room for a car and storage.

Carport. Open sides, cheaper and quicker to build, and it keeps rain and sun off the car.

Combination. Several models join a closed garage with a carport or a covered terrace under one roof.

Size. Footprints run from 3 x 5 m to 8.8 x 5.8 m. Check the internal size on the product page against your car, and leave room to open the doors.

Economic or Premium. Six models come in both sets.

Base. A concrete slab is best under a garage. Check height and boundary limits with your local planning authority before you build.

Need storage only? See sheds and storage cabins.
